33987-beautiful-shells-of-new-zealand-an.title: Directions for Collecting and Cleaning them.
33987-beautiful-shells-of-new-zealand-an.creator: Unknown
33987-beautiful-shells-of-new-zealand-an.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Often have I heard my young friends regret the great difficulty experienced in identifying the things of beauty found on our coast; and some time back it occurred to me that the time had arrived when an attempt should be made to remedy this.

arxiv-2012-00260.title: Near-Optimal Control Strategy in Leader-Follower Networks: A Case Study for Linear Quadratic Mean-Field Teams
arxiv-2012-00260.creator: Mohammad M. Baharloo, Jalal Arabneydi, Amir G. Aghdam
arxiv-2012-00260.description: Abstract In this paper, a decentralized stochastic control system consisting of one leader and many homogeneous followers is studied. The leader and followers are coupled in both dynamics and cost, where the dynamics are linear and the cost function is quadratic in the states and actions of the leader and followers.

arxiv-2201-11303.title: Mutation Analysis: Answering the Fuzzing Challenge
arxiv-2201-11303.creator: Rahul Gopinath, Philipp Görz, Alex Groce
arxiv-2201-11303.description: Abstract Fuzzing is one of the fastest growing fields in software testing. The idea behind fuzzing is to check the behavior of software against a large number of randomly generated inputs, trying to cover all interesting parts of the input space, while observing the tested software for anomalous behaviour.

arxiv-2203-17080.title: Notes on self-dual gravity
arxiv-2203-17080.creator: Pujian Mao, Weicheng Zhao
arxiv-2203-17080.description: Abstract Notes on self-dual gravity Pujian Mao and Weicheng Zhao Center for Joint Quantum Studies and Department of Physics, School of Science, Tianjin University, 135 Yaguan Road, Tianjin 300350, China Abstract . In this paper, we study self-dual gravity in the Newman-Penrose formalism. We specify the self-dual solution space from the Newman-Unti solutions.

arxiv-2206-11560.title: Distinguishing nonstandard scalar and fermionic charged particles at future e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} collider
arxiv-2206-11560.creator: Anjan Kumar Barik, Rafiqul Rahaman, Santosh Kumar Rai
arxiv-2206-11560.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Anjan Kumar Barik, Rafiqul Rahaman, Santosh Kumar Rai. We investigate the possibility to identify the intrinsic spin of exotic charged particles at the future e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} collider in l ± + 2 ​ j + E T l^{\pm}+2j+\cancel{E}_{T} final state. We choose the Inert Doublet Model (IDM) and Minimal supersymmetric Standard Model (MSSM), as examples for the new physics models with scalar and fermionic exotic charged particles, respectively.

arxiv-2208-12026.title: An adaptive kernel estimator for the intensity function of spatio-temporal point processes
arxiv-2208-12026.creator: Jonatan A. González, Paula Moraga
arxiv-2208-12026.description: Abstract In spatio-temporal point pattern analysis, one of the main statistical objectives is to estimate the first-order intensity function, i.e., the expected number of points per unit area and unit time. This estimation is usually carried out non-parametrically through kernel functions, where one of the most frequent handicaps is the selection of kernel bandwidths prior to estimation.

arxiv-2311-07940.title: Coherent transient exciton transport in disordered polaritonic wires
arxiv-2311-07940.creator: Gustavo J. R. Aroeira, Kyle T. Kairys, Raphael F. Ribeiro
arxiv-2311-07940.description: Abstract Excitation energy transport can be significantly enhanced by strong light-matter interactions. In the present work, we explore intriguing features of coherent transient exciton wave packet dynamics on a lossless disordered polaritonic wire. Our main results can be understood in terms of the effective exciton group velocity, a new quantity we obtain from the polariton dispersion.

arxiv-2507-18701.title: Orbital statistics of multiple systems formed from small- N N subclusters 2024 Orbital statistics of multiple systems formed from small- N N subclusters –
arxiv-2507-18701.creator: Hannah E. Ambrose, A. P. Whitworth
arxiv-2507-18701.description: Abstract We use numerical N N -body experiments to explore the statistics of multiple systems formed in small- N N subclusters, i.e. the distributions of orbital semi-major axis, a a , orbital eccentricity, e e , mass ratio, q q , mutual orbital inclination, θ \theta , and ejection velocity, υ ej \upsilon_{\rm ej} .

arxiv-2602-12110.title: Testing and Validation of the Updated Pixel-Based Non-Linearity Calibration File for WFC3/IR
arxiv-2602-12110.creator: K. Huynh, V. Bajaj, M. Marinelli, J. Mack, S. Shenoy, N. Grogin
arxiv-2602-12110.description: Abstract The WFC3/IR channel has an innate non-linear response to incident photons, which is corrected for in the calwf3 pipeline with the NLINFILE reference file. The 2009 solution is based on an average polynomial correction for each IR quadrant and is found to be poorly constrained at high fluence levels ( e − e^{-} ) approaching the saturation limit.

Dale, Sanskriti Das, Simthembile Dlamini, Simon Glover, Kathryn Kreckel, Laura A. Lopez, Sebastian Lopez, Smita Mathur, Hsi-An Pan, Jennifer A. Rodriguez, Karin Sandstrom, Sumit K. Sarba
arxiv-2602-20397.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Erik B. Monson, Bret D. Lehmer, Amirnezam Amiri, Karina Barboza, Ashley T. Barnes, Antara R. Basu-Zych, Daniel A. Dale, Sanskriti Das, Simthembile Dlamini, Simon Glover, Kathryn Kreckel, Laura A. Lopez, Sebastian Lopez, Smita Mathur, Hsi-An Pan, Jennifer A. Rodriguez, Karin Sandstrom, Sumit K. Sarba. We investigate the relationship between star formation and X-ray emission from the hot interstellar medium (ISM) on ∼ \sim kpc scales in NGC 4254 (M99) by combining spatially resolved star formation histories (SFHs) and Bayesian X-ray spectral fitting.

britannica-1911-della-porta-giovanni-bat.title: Della Porta, Giovanni Battista (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-della-porta-giovanni-bat.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-della-porta-giovanni-bat.description: Article 'Della Porta, Giovanni Battista' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Italian natural philosopher, was born of a noble and ancient family at Naples about the year 1538. He travelled extensively not only in Italy but also in France and Spain, and he was still a youth when he published Magia naturalis, sive de miraculis rerum naturalium lib. (1558), the first draft of his Magia naturalis, in twenty books, published in 1589.

pmc-10773587.title: Serum proteomics reveals a tolerant immune phenotype across multiple pathogen taxa in wild vampire bats
pmc-10773587.creator: Amanda Vicente-Santos, Lauren R. Lock, Meagan Allira, Kristin E. Dyer, Annalise Dunsmore, Weihong Tu, Dmitriy V. Volokhov, Claudia Herrera, Guang-Sheng Lei, Ryan F. Relich, Michael G. Janech, Alison M. Bland, Nancy B. Simmons, Daniel J. Becker
pmc-10773587.description: Bats carry many zoonotic pathogens without showing pronounced pathology, with a few exceptions. The underlying immune tolerance mechanisms in bats remain poorly understood, although information-rich omics tools hold promise for identifying a wide range of immune markers and their relationship with infection.

pmc-11432908.title: The Usability and Feasibility of a Dietary Intake Self-Monitoring Application in a Population with Varying Literacy Levels
pmc-11432908.creator: Beenish Moalla Chaudhry, Katie A. Siek, Kay Connelly
pmc-11432908.description: Objectives: Our aim was to study how hemodialysis patients with varying levels of literacy would use a diet and fluid intake monitoring mobile application (DIMA-P) and what would be its impact on their dietary behaviors. Materials and Methods: We developed a mobile application using user-centered methods and informed by the Integrated Theory of Health Behavior Change (ITHBC).

pmc-11517090.title: 9.P. Scientific session: National perspective on knowledge translation to bridge the gap between research and policy
pmc-11517090.creator: Organised by: Sciensano (Belgium), Chair persons: Robby De Pauw (Belgium), Brecht Devleesschauwer (Belgium)
pmc-11517090.description: National and international public health institutions play a crucial role in guiding public health policies. However, a key challenge in this process is to bridge the gap between the data collected and the insights required to guide decision-makers, commonly referred to as knowledge translation (KT).

pmc-11644460.title: The Dual Effect of Selenium Application in Reducing Fusarium Wilt Disease Incidence in Banana and Producing Se-Enriched Fruits
pmc-11644460.creator: Lina Liu, Chengye Wang, Kesuo Yin, Ming Ni, Yue Ding, Chengyun Li, Si-Jun Zheng, Won Kyong Cho
pmc-11644460.description: Fusarium wilt disease severely constrains the global banana industry. The highly destructive disease is caused by Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense, especially its virulent tropical race 4 (Foc TR4). Selenium (Se), a non-essential mineral nutrient in higher plants, is known to enhance plant resistance against several fungal pathogens.

pmc-11657990.title: Glutamine-αKG axis affects dentin regeneration and regulates osteo/odontogenic differentiation of mesenchymal adult stem cells via IGF2 m6A modification
pmc-11657990.creator: Qinglu Tian, Shiqi Gao, Siying Li, Mian Wan, Xin Zhou, Wei Du, Xuedong Zhou, Liwei Zheng, Yachuan Zhou
pmc-11657990.description: BackgroundMulti-lineage differentiation of mesenchymal adult stem cells (m-ASCs) is crucial for tissue regeneration and accompanied with metabolism reprogramming, among which dental-pulp-derived m-ASCs has obvious advantage of easy accessibility. Stem cell fate determination and differentiation are closely related to metabolism status in cell microenvironment, which could actively interact with epigenetic modification.

pmc-12736021.title: Emodin Enhances Rosiglitazone’s Therapeutic Profile by Dual Modulation of SREBP1-Mediated Adipogenesis and PPARγ-Driven Thermogenesis
pmc-12736021.creator: Meng Li, Yi-Rong Wang, Xue Wang, Xiao-Li Xiao, Yun-Hong Sun, Sheng-An Zhang, Yan-Qi Dang, Kai Wang, Wen-Jun Zhou, Alfredo Caturano
pmc-12736021.description: Background/Objectives: Rosiglitazone (RSG), a potent PPARγ agonist for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), induces adverse adipogenic effects that limit clinical use. We investigated whether emodin (1,3,8-trihydroxy-6-methylanthraquinone, EMO), a natural anthraquinone, mitigates RSG-induced complications while enhancing its insulin-sensitizing benefits in severe obesity.

pmc-13137487.title: FAM83D facilitates EMT and metastasis of cervical cancer via interaction with GSK3β and inactivation of GSK3β/stabilization of Snail signaling
pmc-13137487.creator: Jiaofeng Li, Fengtian Li, Xia Meng, Zhiling Yang, Zhengguang Li, Hualong Tang, Wanglong Zhu, Haoming Li, Xingqiang He, Xinyue Lin, Zhengyu Han, Mei Chen, Yuhan Yang, Jingyi Wang, Kun Zhang
pmc-13137487.description: FAM83D plays a crucial role in cervical cancer (CC) metastasis, though its exact mechanism remains unclear. This study found that FAM83D was significantly upregulated in CC tissues, particularly in metastatic cases, and correlated with advanced tumor stage and poor prognosis.

pmc-13144720.title: Biological use of molybdenum and tungsten stems back to 3.4 billion years ago
pmc-13144720.creator: Aya S Klos, Morgan S Sobol, Joanne S Boden, Eva E Stüeken, Rika E Anderson, Kurt O Konhauser, Betül Kaçar
pmc-13144720.description: The biological significance of the transition metal molybdenum (Mo) lies in its function at the catalytic center of several enzymes that drive a wide spectrum of redox reactions underlying global biogeochemical cycles, yet a paradox persists. While modern life ubiquitously relies on Mo, geochemical evidence suggests that its availability in early Earth’s anoxic oceans was extremely limited.

pmc-13279156.title: Hydrogen gas with hypothermic machine perfusion induces lipidomic alterations in donation-after-cardiac-death rat livers
pmc-13279156.creator: Yusuke Minami, Siddabasave Gowda B. B. Gowda, Kengo Shibata, Sodai Sakamoto, Divyavani Gowda, Tsuyoshi Shimamura, Akinobu Taketomi, Hitoshi Chiba, Moto Fukai, Shu-Ping Hui
pmc-13279156.description: Hypothermic machine perfusion (HMP) combined with hydrogen gas has previously been shown to mitigate ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) in rat liver, but without full recovery of function. This study examined how hydrogen gas modulates hepatic lipid metabolism during HMP using donation after cardiac death (DCD) rat livers. Untargeted liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry was employed to perform comprehensive lipidomic profiling of liver samples.

pmc-13303961.title: Engineering Plant-Associated Microorganisms for Bioremediation and Sustainable Agriculture
pmc-13303961.creator: Aurora I. Flores, Luzmaría R. Morales-Cedeño, Pedro D. Loeza-Lara, Mauricio Schoebitz, Ma. del Carmen Orozco-Mosqueda, Gustavo Santoyo
pmc-13303961.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). As food demand increases, agricultural practices have evolved, prompting increased exploration of sustainable ecological techniques and utilization of plant-associated microorganisms. In this context, plant fitness has been enhanced by plant growth-promoting microorganisms (PGPM), which stimulate growth through direct mechanisms, such as improved nutrient availability and phytohormone production, as well as indirect mechanisms, including protection against phytopathogens and suppression of soil-borne diseases. However, these innate capabilities of PGPM can be further improved through genomic modification or editing.

pmc-13586168.title: Mechanistic insight into low-temperature alkylation of thiophene with styrene over zeolites MCM-22 and β
pmc-13586168.creator: Xiaopan Li, Sensen Shang, Chenyu Liu, Jingjing Diao, Xiang Li, Xiaojun Lv, Qingbo Zhao
pmc-13586168.description: Friedel-Crafts alkylation reactions are generally accepted to proceed by an electrophilic aromatic substitution (SEAr) mechanism. Here, we observed that MCM-22 exhibited a high activity in the alkylation of thiophene with styrene at temperatures near ambient, while β was almost inactive.

uslaw-usc-t49-s46308.title: 49 U.S.C. § 46308 — Interference with air navigation
uslaw-usc-t49-s46308.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s46308.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part A (Air Commerce And Safety); Subpart iv (Enforcement And Penalties); Chapter 463 (Penalties). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A person shall be fined under title 18, imprisoned for not more than 5 years, or both, if the person— (1) with intent to interfere with air navigation in the United States, exhibits in the United States.
